description: A key-value cache layer with TTL, fill leases and invalidation, consumed through a library driver. A provider service emits this configuration group; a consumer opens the named driver with it.

keys.name: driver
keys.description: The driver a consumer opens, as registered with cache.Register, e.g. "redis".

keys.name: connection
keys.description: The driver-specific connection string. For "redis": a redis:// or rediss:// URL.
